children: Pinterest's 3Q revenue grows 12% year over year to $1.17 billion, with the U.S. and Canada driving much of the gain at $894 million, up 14%. Rest of World revenue jumps 24% to $87 million, the fastest-growing region. European revenue stays flat at $193 million. CEO Bill Ready says the company is focused on scaling its performance advertising solutions and building an ecosystem that captures high-intent discovery.
